entities.name: Aleksandra Przegalińska
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aleksandra Katarzyna Przegalińska is a Polish philosopher and futurist, specializing in artificial intelligence (AI), human-machine interaction, and digital society. She is a vice-rector for Innovation and AI at Kozminski University in Warsaw, where she also serves as associate professor in the Department of Management in Digital and Networked Societies.
